title: Default extensions and the Catalog
steps: Vim is an extension now, on by default, and nothing about it should feel different. NORMAL in the status bar is its status bar item. Try what you use: `:e Chores`, `:w`, `:vs`, `:sp`, `:tabe Welcome`, `:tabm 0`, Ctrl-W h, j, k, l, s, v, o and c, gt and gT, gd on a link, and Ctrl-O and Ctrl-I across notes. Settings JSON files have Vim too.
⌘⇧P, Show extensions: Vim and Live preview are listed with the other built-ins. Vim's entry lists every key sequence it adds, with the command each runs.
Turn Vim off and reload: standard keys everywhere, and no mode in the status bar. Turn it back on.

Turn Live preview off and reload: headings keep their #, bold its **, links their brackets. Todos still draw as checkboxes, since they're the Todos extension. The `editor.livePreview` setting still turns every preview off and on at once, without a reload. Turn Live preview back on.

Customize Vim: its JavaScript is copied to `.common-ink/extensions/vim/` and trusted, and its code opens. Change `showMode("NORMAL")` to `showMode("NORMAL ✎")` and reload: the copy runs, on the app's own CodeMirror. Revert to built-in.
Source on a built-in shows its TypeScript, loaded when you open it.

At the bottom of the Extensions view, the Catalog lists Word count, a first-party extension that isn't on by default. Install it and reload: Show word count asks before reading the note, as any sandboxed extension does, and the Catalog says Installed.
Settings JSON: add `"editor.vim": false`. The problem says Vim is an extension now and where to turn it off.

With dev tools open, reload: the app's first download (its entry script and the modules it preloads) is about 591 kB, 196 kB gzipped, down from 756 kB and 240 kB. Vim, Todos and the rest arrive as chunks of their own as they start; History, Calendar and Contacts only when you open them.
